Scrap/yield allowance on material: 0% LOW, 1% BASE, 3% HIGH. No yield data exists (no prototype, no DFM review, no first-article run).
Warranty allowance: 1.5% LOW, 3% BASE, 6% HIGH of material plus assembly/test labour. No warranty terms, failure-rate data or RMA history exists.

Tooling and NRE one-off envelope per family used only for amortisation sensitivity: HUB 12 000 EUR, WATCH 8 000 EUR, SENSE 3 500 EUR (shared platform), DISPLAY 9 000 EUR, AIS 5 000 EUR; LOW 0.8x, HIGH 1.5x. NO tooling or NRE quotation exists; MBOM tooling lines stay UNPRICED.

Installation and commissioning field labour: HUB 1.2 h, WATCH 1.8 h, SENSE 1.5 h, DISPLAY 2.0 h, AIS 1.3 h per unit at the case labour rate. Professional installation is required for DC-distribution, tank, masthead and battery work. This is a service cost, not manufacturing, and no installer rate exists.

The allowance is derived from the architecture class (D4/D7/D8/D9) and the component register gaps, never from a retrieved price. Its largest single element is the unquoted class-B SOM (HUB), the cellular modem plus SOM (WATCH), the panel plus SOM (DISPLAY) and the third-party AIS receiver module (AIS).

Labour learning factor applied to assembly/test/inspection/calibration hours: volume 1 = 1.00, 10 = 0.95, 100 = 0.85, 500 = 0.78, 1000 = 0.75. This is NOT an observed productivity improvement; it is a labelled assumption consistent with a 90%-style learning curve and must be replaced by a measured time study.
